info.title: RMS Service API
info.description:
Remote Monitoring System (RMS) service for the E4H Digital Platform. It collects facility solar/grid telemetry, evaluates alert rules, creates/pauses IM-service tickets, maintains the center-id-to-HFR-id mapping, and exposes CO2 emissions reference/consumption data consumed by im-services-analytics.

**Authentication**: This service follows the eGov DIGIT convention of embedding authentication in the request body rather than using an `Authorization` header. Endpoints that accept a `RequestInfo` object (see the `RequestInfo` schema) carry the caller's identity via `RequestInfo.authToken` (the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login`) plus `RequestInfo.userInfo` (uuid, userName, roles, tenantId). rms-service itself does not run a Spring Security filter chain; it trusts the caller/API-gateway to have validated this token, and uses `userInfo`/`authToken` only to resolve tenant/actor context for auditing. The 401/403 responses documented on each operation reflect platform/gateway-level behavior for an invalid or missing token, not enforcement inside rms-service.

Not every endpoint in this service takes a `RequestInfo` - the manual admin trigger endpoints (`/v1/trigger`, `/v1/mapping/sync`, `/v1/mapping/validate`) and the CO2 endpoints take no request envelope at all, since they are invoked by CronJobs/internal jobs rather than end users.

Role.description: A role assigned to the requesting user (org.egov.common.contract.request.Role).

UserInfo.description: Authenticated user context (org.egov.common.contract.request.User), embedded inside RequestInfo.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request envelope sent by the caller. `authToken` is the Bearer JWT issued by egov-user (via /user/oauth/token or /user/_login) and, together with `userInfo`, IS the authentication mechanism for this API - there is no separate Authorization header.

authToken.description: Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's /user/oauth/token or /user/_login. This is the auth carrier for the request - rms-service has no separate Authorization header scheme.

Error.description: org.egov.tracer.model.Error - one entry of a generic egov-tracer error response.

ErrorRes.description: Generic egov-tracer error response (org.egov.tracer.model.ErrorRes), returned by rms-service's default exception handling for endpoints that do not catch exceptions themselves (the CO2 controllers). Field names are the actual camelCase Jackson serialization of the tracer library (not the PascalCase RequestInfo/ResponseInfo convention).

TicketStatusUpdateRequest.description: Webhook payload sent by Saura eMitra when a ticket's status changes.

applicationStatus.description: Ticket status from Saura eMitra. Recognized closed statuses (case-insensitive): RESOLVED, CLOSEDAFTERRESOLUTION, REJECTED, CLOSEDAFTERREJECTION.

tenantId.description: Defaults to RequestInfo.userInfo.tenantId, then to rms.default.tenant.id ("in") if omitted.

pausedUntil.description: Required and must be a future timestamp when action=PAUSE. Ignored for RESUME.

FacilityFilter.description: Boundary filter for listing paused facilities. Most-specific level wins: boundaryCodes > block > district > state; at least one must be non-empty.

pausedBy.description: uuid of the requester, resolved to a display name where possible.

TicketPauseExpiryRequest.description: Optional request body - may be omitted entirely (Kubernetes CronJob typically POSTs with an empty/no body).

limit.description: Max expired pauses to reconcile in this call. Defaults to 200, capped at 1000.

MonthlyConsumptionRequest.description: One (facility, month, year) tuple to resolve monthly consumption for. Provide either centerId directly or hfrId (resolved to a centerId via the center-id-to-HFR mapping table).

GridIntensityFactor.description: kg CO2 per kWh grid intensity factor for a tenant/financial-year. `gridIntensityFactor` is the published value; `projectedGridIntensityFactor` is used when the published value is not yet available.

ArchetypeLookup.description: Maps a (state, facility type) pair to an energy-consumption archetype code.

ArchetypeProperties.description: Per-archetype annual energy profile used in the emission formula.

post.summary: Manually trigger the RMS orchestration workflow
post.description: Synchronously runs the full RMS workflow: collects facility telemetry (inverter/panel/center data), evaluates alert rules, and creates IM-service tickets for facilities that trip a rule. Intended for manual/ops triggering or as a CronJob target; normally the same workflow runs on a schedule (rms.scheduler.rule.engine.cron). Takes no request body and returns a plain-text status message (not JSON).

post.summary: Webhook: receive a ticket status update from Saura eMitra
post.description: Called by Saura eMitra when an IM-service ticket's status changes. post.summary: Pause or resume RMS auto-ticket creation for a facility
post.description: action=PAUSE requires a future `pausedUntil` timestamp and upserts an active pause row; action=RESUME deactivates any active pause for the facility (a no-op success if none exists). Publishes a pause/resume audit Kafka event on both paths. Returns 400 if the RMS ticket pause feature is disabled (rms.ticket.pause.enabled=false) or the payload is invalid.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. missing facilityId/action, pausedUntil not in the future, or feature disabled).

post.summary: Fetch monthly solar/grid/total kWh consumption for a batch of facility/month/year requests
post.description: For each requested (facility, month, year), resolves the Selco center id (directly, or via the HFR-id mapping table) and calls the Selco Elmeasure dashboard graph API (POST /selco/center_details/graph, graphType=solarVsGrid_Eb) to retrieve solar and grid kWh for that month, batching the underlying calls per center to cover the full requested date range in one round trip. Entries whose facility cannot be mapped to a center are returned with null consumption values and source=CENTER_NOT_MAPPED. This endpoint does not wrap requests/responses in RequestInfo/ResponseInfo and has no controller-level exception handling - unhandled failures surface as a generic egov-tracer error response.

200.description: Consumption data resolved for each requested tuple (values may be null when unavailable).

get.summary: Fetch all CO2 reference tables for a tenant
get.description: Returns grid intensity factors, archetype lookups, archetype properties, and state sunshine hours for the given tenant, consumed by the im-services-analytics monthly CO2-emissions calculation job. This endpoint takes no RequestInfo/authentication envelope and has no controller-level exception handling - unhandled failures surface as a generic egov-tracer error response.
